::: {#rem-residual-block}

#### Residual connections in `Block`

`Block(width, residual=True)` returns $\vhidval + \operatorname{ReLU}\paren{\matr{W} \vhidval + \vecf{b}}$ for its input $\vhidval$,
a [residual connection](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/backpropagation.html#def-residual-connection) around one [hidden layer](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-hidden-layer).
This block is simpler than those of @he2016resnet,
which go around two or three convolutional layers
and apply the [ReLU](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-relu) after the sum.
The input and output have the same [width](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/neural-nets.html#def-width),
64,
so the sum is defined.

:::
